summary: Forced --plan round on a plan that dispatch 14 had already revised to carry the cycle-1 route-1 decision, so no route changed and no research was integrated. The round's work was verification and decomposition: all nine of Phase 21's load-bearing anchors were re-checked mechanically against the landed sources and are green -- in particular a sweep of every USForm.untl in every def body of Eliminations.lean and ElimHard.lean confirms case2Rhs is the only contamination site, so Phase 21's five-def Scope Hypothesis stands and it is implementable as written. The substantive finding is that the strict-decrease obligation Phases 22, 23 and 24 each carry is not one obligation but three of very unequal cost; the plan now decomposes it once and each phase cites that decomposition.

artifacts.summary: Revised plan, 28 phases: adds the dispatch-15 anchor-verification table and the shared measure-decrease decomposition, with Phases 21-24 amended to cite them. No phase status, phase number or signature changed.
